user.title: Add news
user.description: One feed per entry: add News again for each source or search. The headlines show on the News ticker and News feed cards.

data.name: Name
data.exclude: Leave out headlines with these words (optional)

data_description.name: Shown on the cards. Leave empty to use the feed's own title.
data_description.include: Separate words or phrases with commas, e.g. Dublin, Cork, home assistant. Matches whole words in the title or summary, ignoring capitals and accents. Empty = every headline.
data_description.exclude: Separate with commas, e.g. football, celebrity. A headline with any of these is dropped.

google.title: Add a Google News search
google.description: Headlines from Google News about anything: a person, a place, a team, a topic.

data.name: Name
data.exclude: Leave out headlines with these words (optional)

data_description.query: For example: home assistant, ram price, gpu stock. Use "quotes" for an exact phrase ("home assistant"), -word to leave a word out (ram price -phone), OR for either word (ram OR ssd), site: for one site (site:bbc.com).
data_description.edition: The country and language of the news.
